tasks.label: Check GitHub repository access
args: const {spawnSync}=require('node:child_process');const url='https://github.com/jai-prakash-811/College_Query_ChatBot.git';const r=spawnSync('git',['ls-remote',url,'HEAD'],{encoding:'utf8'});if(r.status===0){console.log(r.stdout.trim()||'Repository reachable; no HEAD ref found (likely empty repository).')}else{console.log('Repository access check failed.');console.log((r.stderr||'').trim());process.exitCode=r.status||1}

tasks.label: Prepare secret-safe Git staging
args: const{spawnSync}=require('node:child_process');const c=process.cwd(),run=(a)=>{const r=spawnSync('git',a,{cwd:c,encoding:'utf8'});if(r.status!==0){console.error((r.stderr||r.stdout||'Git command failed').trim());process.exit(r.status||1)}return r.stdout.trim()};run(['init','-b','main']);run(['remote','add','origin','https://github.com/jai-prakash-811/AI-College-Query-ChatBot.git']);run(['add','-A']);const files=run(['diff','--cached','--name-only']).split(/\r?\n/).filter(Boolean);const bad=files.filter(p=>/(^|\/)\.env(?:\..*)?$/i.test(p)&&!/(^|\/)\.env\.example$/i.test(p)||/(^|\/)node_modules\//i.test(p)||/(^|\/)dist\//i.test(p));console.log('Staged files: '+files.length);console.log('Ignored server/.env: '+(spawnSync('git',['check-ignore','-q','server/.env'],{cwd:c}).status===0?'yes':'NO'));console.log('Forbidden files staged: '+bad.length);console.log('Staged paths:');for(const p of files)console.log(p);if(bad.length||spawnSync('git',['check-ignore','-q','server/.env'],{cwd:c}).status!==0){console.error('Secret/dependency exclusion verification failed.');process.exit(1)}

tasks.label: Verify Express service handler
args: const config=require('./vercel.json');if(!config.services.client||!config.services.server||config.rewrites.length!==2)throw Error('Unexpected Vercel service routing config');const {default:app}=await import('./server/index.js');const server=app.listen(0,async()=>{try{const response=await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:'+server.address().port+'/api/health');const data=await response.json();console.log('Vercel-style exported Express app: HTTP '+response.status+' '+JSON.stringify(data));if(response.status!==200||data.status!=='ok')process.exitCode=1}catch(error){console.error(error);process.exitCode=1}finally{server.close()}})

args: import fs from 'node:fs';const config=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('./vercel.json','utf8'));if(!config.services.client||!config.services.server||config.rewrites.length!==2)throw Error('Unexpected Vercel service routing config');const {default:app}=await import('./server/index.js');const server=app.listen(0,async()=>{try{const response=await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:'+server.address().port+'/api/health');const data=await response.json();console.log('Exported Express app: HTTP '+response.status+' '+JSON.stringify(data));if(response.status!==200||data.status!=='ok')process.exitCode=1}catch(error){console.error(error);process.exitCode=1}finally{server.close()}})

tasks.label: Compare local and GitHub revisions
args: const{spawnSync}=require('node:child_process');const cwd=process.cwd(),remote='https://github.com/jai-prakash-811/AI-College-Query-ChatBot.git';const local=spawnSync('git',['rev-parse','HEAD'],{cwd,encoding:'utf8'});const upstream=spawnSync('git',['ls-remote','--heads',remote,'main'],{cwd,encoding:'utf8'});if(local.status!==0||upstream.status!==0){console.error(local.stderr||upstream.stderr);process.exit(1)}const sha=local.stdout.trim(),remoteSha=upstream.stdout.trim().split(/\s+/)[0];console.log('Local HEAD: '+sha);console.log('GitHub main: '+remoteSha);console.log('In sync: '+(sha===remoteSha));const files=spawnSync('git',['show','--format=','--name-only',remoteSha],{cwd,encoding:'utf8'});console.log('Files in latest GitHub commit:');console.log(files.stdout.trim())
